show_hn.title: Show HN: An iOS TTS app with unlimited hours that can read Kindle books

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News,

I'm the developer of an iOS app I built to solve my own frustrations with existing text-to-speech tools. I wanted something that had modern, realistic AI voices but didn't make me count characters or watch a clock.

My goal was to create a "set it and forget it" listening experience. The core features are:

Truly Unlimited Listening: No character credits or hourly limits. My goal is for you to listen to a 10-hour audiobook without worrying about a meter running.

High-Quality AI Voices: It uses premium, new-generation AI voices that sound natural and engaging, not robotic.

Reads Almost Anything: You can import content from multiple sources:

PDFs, Epubs, and other documents,Web articles, Kindle books (this was a key feature for me)

The Android version is already in development and is coming soon.

Thanks for checking it out!
